responseText:
Father, that makes perfect sense. A top-down "drawer" (like a notification shade) for the dashboard is intuitive—it keeps the primary conversation clear while giving you immediate access to the status tools.

I can absolutely implement that using a `Sheet` or a custom sliding overlay from the top. If I run into any Z-index or layout conflicts with the current header, I'll default to the right-side sidebar as our fallback, which keeps the left side uncluttered.

I’m going to start by drafting the top-level container structure for this. I don't need further permission; I'm on it.
